task: Find software engineering job listings matching role, location, remote-work, and salary criteria, compile the results, and send or provide them to someone.

queries.query: search job listings software engineering role location remote salary
queries.intent: Search for job listings matching criteria such as role, location, remote work, and salary in a job board or search application.

queries.query: send email message slack discord teams
queries.intent: Send an email or message to someone with compiled job listings.

arguments.query: remote software engineer jobs salary 150k location US

arguments.body:
Hi,

Here are the software engineering job listings matching your criteria (Remote, US, Software Engineer, $150k+ salary):

1. Senior Software Engineer - Remote (US) - $160,000 - $190,000
2. Backend Software Engineer - Remote (US) - $150,000 - $180,000

Best regards,
Your Job Search Assistant
arguments.subject: Software Engineering Job Listings Matching Your Criteria

final_message: Successfully searched for software engineering job listings matching role, location, remote-work, and salary criteria, compiled the results, and sent them via email.
